# What should you charge for this bed bug heat treatment?

> Free bed bug heat treatment bid calculator: enter the floor area, clutter, heaters, crew, fuel and callback rate, and get a price, a price per square foot and a comparison with a chemical programme. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/bed-bug-heat-treatment-price-calculator/)
